comment: Solar wind speeds received 2 brief enhancements yesterday likely due to weak CME and coronal hole effects. Coronal hole influence is anticipated to continue through the first two forecast periods before gradually waning in the third. The first period may also see some glancing effects from a CME from a filament eruption which left the Sun on the 14th. This may result in some isolated STORM G1 spells of geomagnetic activity.
role: independent advisory; score_effect=0 until prospective validation
